title: 7" Santoku knife
text: 7" Santoku knife. I purchased this knife to replace an old kitchenaid cheapy Santoku knife I purchased years ago.  The pink plastic handle finally gave up the ghost - it had a 5" blade.  I didn't think 7" was that big a difference, but it is.  This knife is HUGE.  I think I am just used to using the 5" blade.  The handle is comfortable to hold.  The blade is sharp and so far keeps an edge fairly well.  I sharpen my knives about every 2nd wash.  I do have to get use the giant blade, but overall it is a very, very nice knife in use and appearance.  The information given on the knife appear to accurate.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Ergo Chef Crimson Series 7" Santoku Japanese Chef Knife Forged High Carbon X50CrMoV15 German Stainless Steel - Hollow Ground Blade - G10 Handle
features: Fast, Efficient: From fruits and vegetables to meat, it delivers versatility and precision! Made with German X50CrMoV15 steel and featuring a precision sharp 18-degree edge. It provides an effortless rock and roll motion for smoother slicing.

Essential: The perfect choice for chefs and foodies alike. The ultra-sharp edge effortlessly chops, minces, slices and dices. Hollow ground edge helps reduce friction and prevent food from sticking for smoother and quicker cuts.

Cook with Confidence: Designed for superior control, our knife offers an abbreviated bolster and full tang for durability and perfect balance. The smooth, ergonomic seamless handle promotes a natural grip, so you work more comfortably and efficiently.

Professional Quality: Seamless G10 Military Grade handles, it’s stylishly durable. It’s even vacuum heat treated to 58-59 HRC, delivering razor-sharp edge retention for reliable results. Perfect for slicing, vegetable, fruit and meat with ease.

Shop Risk-Free: Great meals require great tools! Our professional Santoku knife is backed by a limited lifetime warranty, protecting against defects in workmanship. If you have any problems or questions, don’t hesitate to let our service team know.
